def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.2's load (Q-49-22): 24 rounds, six minutes of fire at the cannon's 15,000 ms cycle. 120 damage is cut C's, chosen against the line tank's own armour: four rounds through its 400 cm front hull facet and one more through its 200 internals, three through a 250 side, and two through the 150 rear.
